newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian sets wife ablaze over $2 food allowance.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian sets wife ablaze over $2 food allowance.

text.p: A Nigerian bus driver set his wife on fire during an argument over the monthly food allowance of 200 naira ($2.50) he gives her, a local newspaper reported on Thursday.
PM News said the driver, who claimed his wife was using the money for buying cosmetics, got furious when he arrived home and discovered there was no food for him.
The woman was rescued from burning to death by neighbours but is now in critical condition at a hospital in Benin city.
